content.thinking:
I'm drafting the paragraph now and keeping it free of figures. The fact that nobody was paged is the only cost to responders I need to state. I'll describe the slowdown as what readers saw, saying pages loaded more slowly and took longer, rather than putting a size on it. The affected group is shoppers with long purchase histories.

I'm settling how to name the fix: Argus has a rollback still in place with automatic sync turned off, and the proposed fix is only a draft pull request that hasn't been merged or run yet. I'll describe it as a draft pull request without quoting its number, since I'd rather not put a figure in.

input.overview: Shop pages on io-shop loaded slowly for shoppers for {duration}. A code change made the shop work out each shopper's average spend by adding up their whole purchase history again for every purchase in it. Because of this, account pages took longer to build for shoppers with long purchase histories. Argus estimates the cost to the shop in lost takings at {customer_loss}. Nobody was paged, and no on-call incident was linked to this one. Argus ended the incident by rolling back the io-shop deployment. The rollback is confirmed and still in place, and automatic sync has been left off. Argus has also proposed a permanent fix, but it is still an unreviewed draft and has not been put into use.
